```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)

payload <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$payload_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)

esc_html <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L || is.na(x)) return("")
  s <- as.character(x)
  s <- gsub("&", "&amp;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("<", "&lt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub(">", "&gt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub('"', "&quot;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s
}

render_edatopic_svg <- function(cells_list, title_text) {
  snrs <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")
  rows <- as.character(0:8)
  cell_w <- 48L
  cell_h <- 28L
  pad_l <- 48L
  pad_t <- 42L
  w <- pad_l + length(snrs) * cell_w + 16L
  h <- pad_t + length(rows) * cell_h + 18L

  max_cnt <- 1L
  cell_map <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())
  if (!is.null(cells_list)) {
    for (ci in cells_list) {
      k <- paste0(as.character(ci$smr), "|", toupper(as.character(ci$snr)))
      cnt <- as.integer(ci$count)
      if (cnt > max_cnt) max_cnt <- cnt
      assign(k, cnt, envir = cell_map)
    }
  }

  parts <- c(
    sprintf('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" width="%d" height="%d" role="img" aria-label="%s">', w, h, w, h, esc_html(title_text)),
    sprintf('<rect x="0" y="0" width="%d" height="%d" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d8d8d8" rx="3"/>', w, h),
    sprintf('<text x="%d" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">%s</text>', as.integer(w / 2), esc_html(title_text))
  )
  for (ci in seq_along(snrs)) {
    cx <- pad_l + (ci - 1L) * cell_w + (cell_w / 2.0)
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="35" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#313132">%s</text>', cx, snrs[[ci]]))
  }
  for (ri in seq_along(rows)) {
    ry <- pad_t + (ri - 1L) * cell_h
    r_lbl <- rows[[ri]]
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%.1f" text-anchor="end" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#313132">%s</text>', pad_l - 6L, ry + cell_h * 0.66, r_lbl))
    for (ci in seq_along(snrs)) {
      cx <- pad_l + (ci - 1L) * cell_w
      k <- paste0(r_lbl, "|", snrs[[ci]])
      cnt <- if (exists(k, envir = cell_map, inherits = FALSE)) get(k, envir = cell_map) else 0L
      fill <- "#f8fafc"
      txt <- "#64748b"
      if (cnt > 0L) {
        ratio <- cnt / max_cnt
        if (ratio >= 0.7) {
          fill <- "#003366"
          txt <- "#ffffff"
        } else if (ratio >= 0.35) {
          fill <- "#38598A"
          txt <- "#ffffff"
        } else {
          fill <- "#dbeafe"
          txt <- "#003366"
        }
      }
      parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<rect x="%d" y="%d" width="%d" height="%d" fill="%s" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="0.8"/>', cx, ry, cell_w, cell_h, fill))
      if (cnt > 0L) {
        parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="%.1f" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="%s">%d</text>', cx + cell_w / 2.0, ry + cell_h * 0.66, txt, cnt))
      }
    }
  }
  paste(c(parts, "</svg>"), collapse = "\n")
}
```

```{r header_block, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("<h2>%s</h2>\n", esc_html(payload$title)))
cat(sprintf(
  "<p><strong>Project:</strong> %s &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>BGC Scope:</strong> %s &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Total Plots:</strong> %d &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Site Units:</strong> %d</p>\n",
  esc_html(payload$project),
  esc_html(payload$bgcLabel),
  as.integer(payload$plotCount),
  as.integer(length(payload$unitSummaries))
))
```

### Subzone Edatopic Envelope

```{r edatopic_block, results='asis'}
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  cat('<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:16px;">\n')
  cat(render_edatopic_svg(payload$relativeGrid, "Subzone Relative Edatope (rSMR x rSNR)"))
  cat(render_edatopic_svg(payload$actualGrid, "Subzone Actual Edatope (aSMR x rSNR)"))
  cat("</div>\n")
}
```

### Classified Site Units Overview

```{r unit_overview}
if (!is.null(payload$unitSummaries) && length(payload$unitSummaries) > 0L) {
  u_rows <- lapply(payload$unitSummaries, function(u) {
    data.frame(
      `Site Unit` = as.character(u$siteUnit),
      Plots = as.integer(u$nPlots),
      `Mean Elev (m)` = as.numeric(u$meanElev),
      `Modal rSMR` = as.character(u$modalSmr),
      `Modal rSNR` = as.character(u$modalSnr),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, u_rows))
}
```

### Diagnostic and Constant Species Across Subzone

```{r veg_table}
if (!is.null(payload$vegetationTable) && length(payload$vegetationTable) > 0L) {
  veg_rows <- lapply(payload$vegetationTable, function(r) {
    data.frame(
      Strata = as.character(r$layer),
      Code = as.character(r$species),
      `Scientific Name` = as.character(r$scientificName),
      `Presence Class` = as.character(r$constancyClass),
      `Constancy (%)` = round(as.numeric(r$constancyPct), 1),
      `Mean Cover (%)` = round(as.numeric(r$meanCover), 1),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, veg_rows))
}
```
